name: Solomon Islands

flag.description: Divided diagonally from lower hoist to upper fly by a thin yellow stripe, with a blue upper hoist triangle containing five white five-pointed stars arranged in an X, and a green lower fly triangle.
flag.symbolism: Blue represents the water, green the land and yellow the sunshine; the five stars originally stood for the country's five main island districts.

hook: Five white stars in an X on a blue triangle, then a thin yellow diagonal and green below; Tanzania's diagonal is a wide black band edged in yellow.
trivia: Guadalcanal, home of the capital Honiara, was the scene of a major Second World War campaign in 1942–43.
The country is made up of nearly a thousand islands spread over about 1,500 km of ocean.
